segments.name: Marketplace
segments.description: Online marketplace facilitating lawful sales of firearms, ammunition, and hunting/shooting accessories through federally-licensed dealers.
segments.evidence: The Marketplace segment consists of the GunBroker e-commerce marketplace ("Marketplace"), which, in its role as a marketplace platform, supports the lawful sale of firearms, ammunition, and hunting/shooting accessories.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue from marketplace fees including marketplace revenue, service fees, advertising campaigns, and shipping revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from marketplace fees, which include marketplace revenue, marketplace service fee revenue, advertising campaign revenue and shipping revenue.
